instruction: Write rot13.py: stdin → stdout rot13 transform, preserving case and non-letters. `echo 'Hello, World!' | python3 rot13.py` must print 'Uryyb, Jbeyq!'.

grader.script: [ "$(echo 'Hello, World!' | python3 rot13.py)" = 'Uryyb, Jbeyq!' ] && [ "$(echo 'Uryyb' | python3 rot13.py)" = 'Hello' ]
